fields.doc: 🪵 Horizontal modulus of subgrade reaction k_h [N/m³] (constant with depth) of the Winkler foundation of the lateral pile; 0 = not given.
fields.en: Horizontal subgrade modulus k_h (0 = not given)

🌋 Horizontal seismic coefficient k_h of the pseudo-static Mononobe-Okabe thrust (RW-08, EN 1998-5 §7.3); 0 = no seismic situation.
